brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases (piece:0..3,0,0;full) each hold a drained bin (bin:0..3,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain). Only the third-depth bins clear the pipe. Every full-depth bin, half-depth bin and 'PVC bore' bin was refused with MESH_CLASH against the pipe (about 1.35–1.42 mm overlap). So each planter cell is shallow.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 enters (0,0) from the west edge and passes through (1,0), (2,0) and (3,0) at level 0. The collision check reads clear.

The pipe passes under the drained bin in all four cells, so it reaches every cell. The build does not show how water gets out of the pipe into a bin; that depends on outlets you drill or fit in the pipe, which the configurator doesn't model. No hose barb or other inlet fitting is placed at the pipe ends.

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter: four full hex bases in a straight row from (0,0) to (3,0), joined with three joint bolts. A straight pipe run (run-1) passes through all four bases at level 0. Each cell holds a shallow (third-depth) drained bin. The pipe went in first because every deeper bin clashed with it, including the bins sold with a "PVC bore". The checks pass with no errors and the collision check reads clear. The only issue left is a note that 18 outer faces could take caps.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.
